turns.text: I need a set of matching plant-shop ads, and I’m probably overthinking how to explain this because I want them to feel like they belong together. I always worry that an ad can look lovely at first glance but become hard to read when you actually try to find the details. The formats I need are 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9, and the wording to include exactly is “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Please use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look across the set. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address, and rearrange things to fit rather than shrinking the whole design.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the generation because the account has insufficient credits, so **no ads were created**.

Here’s the layout plan for the matching set, keeping every line readable rather than scaling down one design:

- **1:1:** Centered text, with leafy plants framing the lower corners.
- **9:16:** A spacious vertical stack, with plants along the sides and a dedicated address footer.
- **16:9:** Text on the left, a leafy plant grouping on the right, and a prominent address below the dates.

All three would use cream backgrounds, forest-green type, sage accents, and this exact wording:

> Fern House  
> Weekend Plant Sale  
> 20% off all indoor plants  
> Saturday & Sunday  
> Visit 24 Willow Lane

The address would stay bold, unobstructed, and at least as readable as the dates. Generation can be retried once credits are available.

args.name: Fern House — Square Plant Sale Ad

style.prompt: Create a polished, highly legible square 1:1 graphic advertisement for a boutique plant shop. Matching campaign design language: warm ivory cream background #F6F2E7, rich forest green #194B36 typography, sage green accents, elegant realistic leafy indoor plant cutouts (monstera, fern, rubber plant) grouped around the lower corners and edges, restrained editorial botanical aesthetic. Strong clean typography, generous whitespace, crisp dark text on cream, flat print-ready graphic, no mockup. Include exactly these five text lines, each once, faithfully spelled and with no additional text: "Fern House"; "Weekend Plant Sale"; "20% off all indoor plants"; "Saturday & Sunday"; "Visit 24 Willow Lane". Visual hierarchy: brand at top in elegant bold serif; large bold clean sans-serif sale headline arranged as one easily readable line; offer in a prominent pale sage panel; dates beneath; address in a dedicated high-contrast cream footer region with generous padding and bold highly legible forest-green sans serif, not small fine print. Address must be as readable as the dates. Use leafy imagery decoratively, never behind or overlapping any text. Balanced square-specific composition, all text inside generous safe margins. Prioritize accuracy of all five exact text lines and effortless reading over decoration.
